waiting.title: Updating the app badge no longer freezes the app (APPLE-IOS-47)
waiting.reporter: Sentry APPLE-IOS-47 (11 users, 12 events; 3 users in last 24h on builds 30 & 33)
waiting.plain: When the app updated the red badge number on its icon it waited on iOS’s notification service while holding the screen, freezing 7–8 s. The fix moves that onto the app’s existing background queue for notifications (same one used for the APPLE-IOS-36 fix). +196/−17 across 3 files with new NotificationQueueTests.
waiting.check: CI/unit tests green (none had run on head 17cd0d2 as of ~9:38 AM PT; PR is a draft). After the next build, APPLE-IOS-47 should get no new events on it. Smoke test: open Activity, read notifications, icon badge clears with no stutter.
